sourceSummary: Middlesbrough 2026/27 post-window roster cross-check using FootballSquads and current club/parent-club confirmation, with Transfermarkt latest published valuations. Three stale identities are corrected before research publication: Seny Dieng, Finley Munroe and Morgan Whittaker are replaced by current-role equivalents Radek Vitek, Ashley Phillips and Amario Cozier-Duberry.

Radek Vitek.notes: ASCII football name retained to match the corrected identity record for Radek Vítek. FootballSquads supplies current Middlesbrough roster truth; €6m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation.

Ashley Phillips.notes: Tottenham confirms the permanent 15 August 2026 Middlesbrough transfer; €7m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation.

Max Arfsten.notes: Current Middlesbrough usage is left-back/left wing-back; mapped to SWOS LB code 2. €5m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation from before the August transfer.

Sebastian Berhalter.notes: FootballSquads supplies current Middlesbrough roster truth; €8m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation from his Vancouver period. Central/defensive midfield maps to SWOS code 6.

Myles Peart-Harris.notes: Attacking midfield maps to SWOS midfield code 6.

Jeremy Sarmiento.notes: Primary left-wing role maps to SWOS LW/LM code 5.

Will Lankshear.notes: FootballSquads supplies current Middlesbrough roster truth; €7m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation from his Tottenham registration. Centre-forward maps to SWOS attack code 7.

Amario Cozier-Duberry.notes: Brighton confirms the 1 September 2026 season-long Middlesbrough loan. Primary right-wing role maps to SWOS RW/RM code 4; €5m is the latest published Transfermarkt valuation.
